privacyNotice.title: Privacy Notice & User Consent
privacyNotice.subtitle: Please understand how your personal and healthcare information is handled before creating your account.
privacyNotice.welcomeBody1: Thank you for choosing SEHATSETU, an AI-powered healthcare platform designed to provide accessible, secure, and quality healthcare services. Your privacy is important to us, and we are committed to handling your personal information responsibly.
privacyNotice.welcomeBody2: By continuing, you acknowledge that you understand how your information will be collected, used, stored, and protected while using our platform.
privacyNotice.dpdpBody: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 is India's primary law governing the collection, processing, storage, and protection of digital personal data. It was passed by Parliament in August 2023 to strengthen individual privacy rights and establish responsibilities for organizations handling personal information.
privacyNotice.dpdpBody2: Because SEHATSETU manages healthcare-related information, the platform is designed around the privacy principles established by the Act.
privacyNotice.infoCollectedItem1: Name, age, gender, phone number and email address.
privacyNotice.infoCollectedItem2: Symptoms, medical history, allergies, medications, consultation records, prescriptions and diagnostic reports.
privacyNotice.infoCollectedItem4: Voice recordings when required for AI-assisted prescription features during consultations.
privacyNotice.infoCollectedItem5: Technical information required for account security and platform performance.
privacyNotice.whyCollectItem1: Create and manage your healthcare account and enable secure doctor consultations.
privacyNotice.whyCollectItem2: Generate and store digital prescriptions and maintain your Electronic Health Record.
privacyNotice.whyCollectItem3: Provide medical summaries, nutrition recommendations and follow-up reminders.
privacyNotice.whyCollectItem4: Improve healthcare quality, platform performance and user experience.
privacyNotice.whyCollectItem5: Comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
privacyNotice.dataProtectionBody: SEHATSETU is designed to securely store personal and medical information, restrict access to authorized users, apply industry-standard security practices, and maintain patient confidentiality throughout consultations and record management.
privacyNotice.rightsItem1: Know what personal information is collected about you and access your healthcare records.
privacyNotice.rightsItem4: Request deletion of your account and personal data, subject to legal or medical-record retention requirements.
privacyNotice.consentBody: By selecting "I Agree" and creating an account, you confirm that you have read and understood this notice and voluntarily consent to the collection, processing and secure storage of your personal and healthcare information for providing SEHATSETU healthcare services.
privacyNotice.note: Note: This document is provided for informational purposes as part of the SEHATSETU platform. The final privacy policy and legal compliance requirements should be reviewed by qualified legal professionals before production deployment.
privacyNotice.consentCheckbox: I have read and agree to this notice
